title: GFP-Expressing Plasmids with Various Backbones
summary: This cluster consists of 11 GFP-expressing plasmids, each with a unique backbone. UG72-2GFP and UG72-GFP are central plasmids that serve as backbones for several other plasmids, including CIT1-2GFP-ter-URA3, IRE1-2GFP-ter-URA3, NAB2-GFP-ter-URA3, pTPI1-SS-GFP-HDEL-URA3, and OM14-2GFP-ter-URA3. The remaining plasmids, such as CIT1-2GFP-ter-URA3 and IRE1-2GFP-ter-URA3, are derivatives of these central plasmids, indicating a hierarchical relationship between them.
